senses: ἀνα-φωνέω, -ῶ to cry out, exclaim: [[r:LUK.1.42|Luk 1:42]] (Arist., al.).† (AS)

G0401.root: from a comparative of [[w:G0303]] and χέω (to pour)
senses: ἀνά-χυσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀναχέω, to pour out), a pouring out, overflowing, excess: metaphorically, [[r:1PE.4.4|1Pe 4:4]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0402.kjv: depart, give place, go (turn) aside, withdraw self
senses: ἀνα-χωρέω, -ῶ
to go back.

to withdraw: [[r:MAT.9.24|Mat 9:24]]; frequently in sense of avoiding danger (MM, VGT, see word), [[r:MAT.2.12|Mat 2:12]] (but see Thayer), [[r:MAT.2.13|Mat 2:13-14, 22 4:12 12:15 14:13 15:21 27:5]], [[r:MRK.3.7|Mrk 3:7]], [[r:JHN.6.15|Jhn 6:15]], [[r:ACT.23.19|Act 23:19 26:31]].† (AS)

G0403.strongs: properly, a recovery of breath, i.e. (figuratively) revival
senses: ἀνά-ψυξις, -εως, ἡ (ἀναψύχω), a refreshing: [[r:ACT.3.19|Act 3:19.]]† (AS)

G0404.strongs: properly, to cool off, i.e. (figuratively) relieve
senses: ἀνα-ψύχω to refresh: with accusative of person(s), [[r:2TI.1.16|2Ti 1:16]] (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 588).† (AS)

G0405.root: from a derivative of a compound of [[w:G0435]] and [[w:G4228]]
G0405.strongs: an enslaver (as bringing men to his feet)
senses: (ἀνδράποδον, a slave, captured in war) a slave-dealer, kidnapper: [[r:1TI.1.10|1Ti 1:10]] (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀνδρίζω to make a man of. Mid., to play the man (cf. MM, VGT, see word): [[r:1CO.16.13|1Co 16:13.]]† (AS)

G0408.strongs: man of victory; Andronicos, an Israelite
senses: Andronicus: [[r:ROM.16.7|Rom 16:7.]]† (AS)
ἀνδρο-φόνος, -ου, ὁ a man-slayer: [[r:1TI.1.9|1Ti 1:9]] (cf. φονεύς, and see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0410.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G1458]]
senses: ἀν-έγκλητος, -ον (ἀ-, ἐγκαλέω), not to be called to account, unreprovable: [[r:1CO.1.8|1Co 1:8]], [[r:COL.1.22|Col 1:22]], [[r:1TI.3.10|1Ti 3:10]], [[r:TIT.1.6|Tit 1:6-7]].† SYN.: ἄμεμπτος, ἀνεπίλημπτος (see Tr., Syn., § ciii; Cremer, 742; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

G0411.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G1555]]
G0411.strongs: not expounded in full, i.e. indescribable
senses: ἀν-εκδιήγητος, -ον (ἀ-, ἐκδιηγέομαι) inexpressible: [[r:2CO.9.15|2Co 9:15]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0412.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G1583]]
G0412.strongs: not spoken out, i.e. (by implication) unutterable
senses: ἀν-εκ-λάλητος, -ον (ἀ-, ἐκλαλέω), unspeakable: [[r:1PE.1.8|1Pe 1:8.]]† (AS)

G0413.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G1587]]
G0413.strongs: not left out, i.e. (by implication) inexhaustible
senses: (ἀ-, ἐκλείπω), unfailing: [[r:LUK.12.33|Luk 12:33]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
αν-εκτός, -όν (also in late Gk. -ή, -όν; ἀνέχομαι), tolerable: compar., -ότερος, [[r:MAT.10.15|Mat 10:15 11:22, 24]], [[r:LUK.10.12|Luk 10:12, 14]] † (AS)
ἀν-ελεήμων, -ον (-ἀ, ἐλεήμων), without mercy: [[r:ROM.1.13|Rom 1:13.]]† (AS)
ἀνεμίζω = Attic ἀνεμόω (ἄνεμος); pass., to be driven by the wind: [[r:JAS.1.6|Jas 1:6.]]† (AS)

G0417.strongs: wind; (plural) by implication, (the four) quarters (of the earth)
senses: wind: [[r:MAT.11.7|Mat 11:7 14:24, 30 14:32]], [[r:MRK.4.37|Mrk 4:37, 39 4:41 6:48, 51]], [[r:LUK.7.24|Luk 7:24 8:23-24]], [[r:JHN.6.13|Jhn 6:13]], [[r:ACT.27.7|Act 27:7, 14-15]], [[r:JAS.3.4|Jas 3:4]], [[r:REV.6.13|Rev 6:13 7:1]]; pl., [[r:MAT.7.25|Mat 7:25, 27 8:26-27]], [[r:LUK.8.25|Luk 8:25]], [[r:ACT.27.4|Act 27:4]], Ju 12; οἱ τέσσαρες ἄ. τῆς γῆς, [[r:REV.7.1|Rev 7:1]]; hence the four quarters of the heavens (see Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, see word), [[r:MAT.24.31|Mat 24:31]], [[r:MRK.13.27|Mrk 13:27]]; metaphorically, of variable teaching, Eph 414.† SYN.: πνεῦμα, πνοή (and cf. θύελλα, λαῖλαψ). (AS)

G0418.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as [[w:G1735]]
senses: ἀν-ένδεκτος, -ον (ἀ- neg., ἔνδεκτος; ἐνδέχομαι), impossible, inadmissible: [[r:LUK.17.1|Luk 17:1.]]† (AS)

G0419.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G1830]]
G0419.strongs: not searched out, i.e. (by implication) inscrutable
senses: ἀνεξεραύνητος (Rec. -εύνητος, as in Attic; M, Pr., 46), -ον (ερευνάω), unsearchable: [[r:ROM.11.33|Rom 11:33.]]† (AS)
ἀνεξί-κακος, -ον (fut., ἀνέξομαι, κακός) patiently forbearing (cf. ἀνεξικακία, [[r:WIS.2.19|Wis 2:19]]; and see MM, VGT, see word): [[r:2TI.2.24|2Ti 2:24.]]† (AS)

G0421.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of [[w:G1537]] and a derivative of [[w:G2487]]
G0421.strongs: not tracked out, i.e. (by implication) untraceable
senses: (ἀ- neg., ἐξιχνιάζω, to track out; ἴχνος) that cannot be traced out: [[r:ROM.11.33|Rom 11:33]], [[r:EPH.3.8|Eph 3:8]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0422.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of [[w:G1909]] and [[w:G0153]]
senses: ἀν-επ-αίσχυντος, -ον (ἐπαισχύνομαι) not to be put to shame: [[r:2TI.2.15|2Ti 2:15.]]† (AS)

G0423.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G1949]]
senses: ἀν-επί-λημπτος (Rec. -λμπτος; Bl., § 6, 8), -ον (ἀ- ἐπιλαμβάνω) without reproach: [[r:1TI.3.2|1Ti 3:2 5:7 6:14]].† SYN.: ἀμεμπτος, ἀνέγκλητος. It is stronger than these, for it implies not only that the man is of good report, but that he is deservedly so (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
ἀν-έρχομαι to go up: [[r:JHN.6.3|Jhn 6:3]], [[r:GAL.1.17|Gal 1:17-18]] (cf. ἐπανέρχ-; and on its use of "going up " to the capital, MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

(ἀνίημι), a loosening, relaxation: [[r:ACT.24.23|Act 24:23]] (RV, indulgence; cf. MM, VGT, see word); by St. Paul, opposite to θλίψις, expressed or understood, relief: [[r:2CO.2.12|2Co 2:12 7:5 8:13]], [[r:2TH.1.7|2Th 1:7]].† SYN.: ἀνάπαυσις (which see).† (AS)
ἀν-ετάζω (ἀνά, ἐτάζω, to examine; see MM, VGT, see word), to examine judicially: [[r:ACT.22.24|Act 22:24, 29]]..† (AS)
ἄνευ prep. with genitive (rarer than χωρίς, which see; cf. Ellic. on [[r:EPH.2.12|Eph 2:12]]; MM, VGT, 42), without: [[r:MAT.10.29|Mat 10:29]], [[r:1PE.3.1|1Pe 3:1 4:9]].† (AS)
ἀν-εύ-θετος, -ον (see MM, VGT, see word) not well placed, not fit: [[r:ACT.27.12|Act 27:12.]]† (AS)
ἀν-ευρίσκω (ἀνά, εὑρίσκω), to find out by search, discover (see Field, Notes, 47 f.): [[r:LUK.2.16|Luk 2:16]], [[r:ACT.21.4|Act 21:4]].† (AS)

G0430.strongs: to hold oneself up against, i.e. (figuratively) put up with
senses: ἀν-έχω to hold up; in NT always mid., to bear with, endure: in cl. most frequently with accusative, but in NT with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.17.17|Mat 17:17]], [[r:MRK.9.19|Mrk 9:19]], [[r:LUK.9.41|Luk 9:41]], [[r:2CO.11.1|2Co 11:1 11:19]], [[r:EPH.4.2|Eph 4:2]], [[r:COL.3.13|Col 3:13]]; before μικρόν τι, with genitive of person(s) and with genitive of thing(s), [[r:2CO.11.1|2Co 11:1]]; with dative of thing(s), [[r:2TH.1.4|2Th 1:4]] (v M, Th., in l); before εἴ τις, [[r:2CO.11.20|2Co 11:20]]; absol., [[r:1CO.4.12|1Co 4:12]], [[r:2CO.11.4|2Co 11:4]]; to bear with = to listen to, with genitive of person(s), [[r:ACT.18.14|Act 18:14]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:2TI.4.3|2Ti 4:3]], [[r:HEB.13.22|Heb 13:22]] (cf. προσανέχω and MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0431.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a particle of union) and an obsolete νέπος (a brood)
senses: (cf. Lat. nepos), a cousin: [[r:COL.4.10|Col 4:10]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
anise, dill , (Aristophanes Comicus); ionic ἄννησον or ἄνησον (Herdotus Historicus); aeolic ἄννητον, or ἄνητον, (Sapho). (ML)

G0433.strongs: to attain to, i.e. (figuratively) be proper
senses: ἀν-ήκω (ἀνά, ἥκω), prop., to have come up to; in later writers, impers. it is due, it is befitting: in ethical sense (MM, VGT, see word), [[r:EPH.5.4|Eph 5:4]], [[r:COL.3.18|Col 3:18]]; τὸ ἀνῆκον, Phm 8.† (AS)

G0434.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and ἥμερος (lame)
senses: ἀν-ήμερος, -ον (ἀ-, ἥμερο), not tame, savage (MM, VGT, see word): [[r:2TI.3.3|2Ti 3:3.]]† (AS)

G0435.strongs: a man (properly as an individual male)
senses: a man, Lat. vir.
As opposite to a woman, [[r:ACT.8.12|Act 8:12]], [[r:1TI.2.12|1Ti 2:12]]; as a husband, [[r:MAT.1.16|Mat 1:16]], [[r:JHN.4.16|Jhn 4:16]], [[r:ROM.7.2|Rom 7:2]], [[r:TIT.1.6|Tit 1:6]].
As opposite to a boy or infant, [[r:1CO.13.11|1Co 13:11]], [[r:EPH.4.13|Eph 4:13]], [[r:JAS.3.2|Jas 3:2]].

In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, [[r:LUK.5.8|Luk 5:8]]; ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; frequently in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, [[r:ACT.1.16|Act 1:16]]; and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, [[r:ACT.22.3|Act 22:3]]; ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, 19:35.
In general, a man, a male person: = τις, [[r:LUK.8.41|Luk 8:41]], [[r:ACT.6.11|Act 6:11]]. SYN.: ἄνθρωπος, which see (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
ἀνθ-ίοτημι (ἀντί, ἵστημι),
in pres., impf., fut. and 1 aor. act., causal, to set against.

In mid, and pass., also pf. and 2 aor. act., to withstand, resist, oppose: with dative, [[r:MAT.5.39|Mat 5:39]], [[r:LUK.21.15|Luk 21:15]], [[r:ACT.6.10|Act 6:10 13:8]], [[r:ROM.9.19|Rom 9:19 13:2]], [[r:GAL.2.11|Gal 2:11]], [[r:EPH.6.13|Eph 6:13]], [[r:2TI.3.8|2Ti 3:8 4:15]], [[r:JAS.4.7|Jas 4:7]], [[r:1PE.5.9|1Pe 5:9]].† (AS)

G0437.root: from [[w:G0473]] and the middle voice of [[w:G3670]]
G0437.strongs: to confess in turn, i.e. respond in praise
senses: ἀνθ-ομολογέομαι, -οῦμαι (ἀντί, ὁμολογέομαι)
to make a mutual agreement (Dem., Polyb.).
to acknowledge fully, confess (Diod., Polyb., cf. 1Esdras, l.with).
C. dative of person(s), to declare one's praises, speak fully in prayer or thanksgiving, give thanks to (cf. Ps, l.with): [[r:LUK.2.38|Luk 2:38]] (Cremer, 771; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
(ἄνθραξ), a heap of burning coals: [[r:JHN.18.18|Jhn 18:18 21:9]].† (AS)
coal, charcoal:. ἄ. πυρός, a burning coal, [[r:ROM.12.20|Rom 12:20.]]† (AS)
ἀνθρωπ-άρεσκος, -ον (ἄνθρωπος, ἄρεσκος, pleasing), studying to please men: [[r:EPH.6.6|Eph 6:6]], [[r:COL.3.22|Col 3:22]] (Cremer, 642; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0442.kjv: human, common to man, man(-kind), (man-)kind, men's, after the manner of men
senses: (ἄνθρωπος), human, belonging to man: χεῖρες, [[r:ACT.17.25|Act 17:25]]; σοφία, [[r:1CO.2.13|1Co 2:13]]; φύσις, [[r:JAS.3.7|Jas 3:7]]; κτίσις, [[r:1PE.2.13|1Pe 2:13]] (MM, VGT, see word); ἀ. ἡμέρα, opposite to ἡ ἡμ. ([[r:1CO.3.13|1Co 3:13]], God's Judgment-Day), human judgment, [[r:1CO.4.3|1Co 4:3]] (see Lft., Notes, 198); πειρασμὸς ἀ., temptation such as man can bear (AV, such as is common to man, see Field, Notes, 175), [[r:1CO.10.13|1Co 10:13]]; ἀνθρώπινον λέγω, I speak in human fashion, with words not properly weighed, [[r:ROM.6.19|Rom 6:19]] (see Field, Notes, 156).† (AS)
(κτείνω, to kill) a murderer, manslayer (Eur.; see MM, VGT, see word): [[r:JHN.8.44|Jhn 8:44]], [[r:1JN.3.16|1Jn 3:16]].† SYN.: φονεύς, ἀνδροφόνος (see Tr., Syn, § 83) (AS)

G0444.strongs: from); man-faced, i.e. a human being
senses: man:

generically, a human being, male or female (Lat. homo): [[r:JHN.16.21|Jhn 16:21]]; with art., [[r:MAT.4.4|Mat 4:4 12:35]], [[r:MRK.2.27|Mrk 2:27]], [[r:JHN.2.25|Jhn 2:25]], [[r:ROM.7.1|Rom 7:1]], al; disting. from God, [[r:MAT.19.6|Mat 19:6]], [[r:JHN.10.33|Jhn 10:33]], [[r:COL.3.23|Col 3:23]], al.; from animals, etc., [[r:MAT.4.19|Mat 4:19]], [[r:LUK.5.10|Luk 5:10]], [[r:REV.9.4|Rev 9:4]], al.; implying human frailty and imperfection, [[r:1CO.3.4|1Co 3:4]]; σοφία ἀνθρώπων, [[r:1CO.2.5|1Co 2:5]]; ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαι, [[r:1PE.4.2|1Pe 4:2]]; κατὰ ἄνθρωπον περιπατεῖν, [[r:1CO.3.3|1Co 3:3]]; κατὰ ἄ. λέγειν (λαλεῖν), [[r:ROM.3.5|Rom 3:5]], [[r:1CO.9.8|1Co 9:8]]; κατὰ ἄ- λέγειν, [[r:GAL.3.15|Gal 3:15]] (cf. [[r:1CO.15.32|1Co 15:32]], [[r:GAL.1.11|Gal 1:11]]); by meton., of man's nature or condition, ὁ ἔσω (ἔξω) ἄ., [[r:ROM.7.22|Rom 7:22]], [[r:EPH.3.16|Eph 3:16]], [[r:2CO.4.16|2Co 4:16]] (cf. [[r:1PE.3.4|1Pe 3:4]]); ὁ παλαιὸς, καινὸς, νέος ἄ., [[r:ROM.6.6|Rom 6:6]], [[r:EPH.2.15|Eph 2:15 4:22, 24]] [[r:COL.3.9|Col 3:9, 10]]; joined with another subst., ἄ. ἔμπορος, a merchant, [[r:MAT.13.45|Mat 13:45]] (WH, txt. om. ἄ.); οἰκοδεσπότης, [[r:MAT.13.52|Mat 13:52]]; βασιλεύς, 18:23; φάγος, 11:19; with name of nation, Κυρηναῖος, [[r:MAT.27.32|Mat 27:32]]; Ἰουδαῖος, [[r:ACT.21.39|Act 21:39]]; Ῥωμαῖος, [[r:ACT.16.37|Act 16:37]]; pl. οἱ ἄ., men, people: [[r:MAT.5.13|Mat 5:13, 16]] [[r:MRK.8.24|Mrk 8:24]], [[r:JHN.4.28|Jhn 4:28]]; οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων, [[r:MRK.11.2|Mrk 11:2]], [[r:1TI.6.16|1Ti 6:16]].

Indef., ἄ. = τις, some one, a man: [[r:MAT.17.14|Mat 17:14]], [[r:MRK.12.1|Mrk 12:1]], al.; τις ἄ., [[r:MAT.18.12|Mat 18:12]], [[r:JHN.5.5|Jhn 5:5]], al.; indef. one (Fr. on), [[r:ROM.3.28|Rom 3:28]], [[r:GAL.2.16|Gal 2:16]], al.; opposite to women, servants, etc., [[r:MAT.10.36|Mat 10:36 19:10]], [[r:JHN.7.22|Jhn 7:22]], 23.

Definitely, with art., of some particular person; [[r:MAT.12.13|Mat 12:13]], [[r:MRK.3.5|Mrk 3:5]], al.; οὗτος ὁ ἄ., [[r:LUK.14.30|Luk 14:30]]; ὁ ἄ οὗτος, ἐκεῖνος, [[r:MRK.14.71|Mrk 14:71]], [[r:MAT.12.45|Mat 12:45]]; ὁ ἄ. τ. ἀνομίας, [[r:2TH.2.3|2Th 2:3]]; ἄ τ. θεοῦ (of Heb. אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים), [[r:1TI.6.11|1Ti 6:11]], [[r:2TI.3.17|2Ti 3:17]], [[r:2PE.1.21|2Pe 1:21]]; ὁ υἰὸς τοῦ ἀ., see: υἱός. SYN.: ἀνήρ, which see (and cf. MM, VGT, 44; Cremer, 103, 635). (AS)

G0446.strongs: instead of the highest officer, i.e. (specially) a Roman proconsul
senses: ἀνθύπατος -ου, ὁ (ἀντί, ὕπατος, altern. for ὑπέρτατος), supreme, a consul, one acting in place of a consul, a proconsul, the administrator of a senatorial province (cf. ἡγεμών, and see MM, VGT, 44): [[r:ACT.13.7|Act 13:7-8, 12 18:12 19:38]].† (AS)

G0447.strongs: to let up, i.e. (literally) slacken or (figuratively) desert, desist from
senses: ἀν-ίημι (ἀνά, ἵημι),
to send up, produce, to send back.
to let go, leave without support: [[r:HEB.13.5|Heb 13:5]] (cf. [[r:DEU.31.6|Deu 31:6]]; Hom., Iliad., ii, 71).
to relax, loosen (see Field, Notes, 124 f.): [[r:ACT.16.26|Act 16:26 27:40]]; hence, metaphorically, to give up, desist from: [[r:EPH.6.9|Eph 6:9.]]† (AS)
ἀν-έλεος, -ον (Attic ἀνηλεής, ἀνελεήμων; MM, VGT, see word), merciless: [[r:JAS.2.13|Jas 2:13.]]† (AS)

G0449.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G3538]]
senses: (ἀ. neg., νίπτω), unwashed: [[r:MAT.15.20|Mat 15:20]], [[r:MRK.7.5|Mrk 7:5]] (5 Rec).† (AS)

G0450.strongs: to stand up (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive)
G0450.kjv: arise, lift up, raise up (again), rise (again), stand up(-right)
senses: causal, in fut. and 1 aor. act., with accusative, to raise up: [[r:ACT.9.41|Act 9:41]]; from death, [[r:JHN.6.39|Jhn 6:39]], [[r:ACT.2.32|Act 2:32]]; to raise up, cause to be born or appear: [[r:MAT.22.24|Mat 22:24]], [[r:ACT.3.22|Act 3:22, 26]].
Intrans., in mid. and 2 aor act.;

to rise: from lying, [[r:MRK.1.35|Mrk 1:35]]; from sitting, [[r:LUK.4.16|Luk 4:16]]; to leave a place, [[r:MAT.9.9|Mat 9:9]]; pleonastically, as Heb. קוּם, before verbs of going, [[r:MRK.10.1|Mrk 10:1]], al. (see Dalman, Words, 23; M, Pr., 14); of the dead, [[r:MAT.17.23|Mat 17:23]], [[r:MRK.8.31|Mrk 8:31]]; before ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[r:MAT.17.9|Mat 17:9]], [[r:MRK.9.9|Mrk 9:9]];
to arise, appear: [[r:ACT.5.36|Act 5:36]], [[r:ROM.15.12|Rom 15:12]] (cf. ἐπ-, ἐξ- ἀνίστημι, and see Cremer, 306, 738; MM, VGT, see word). SYN.: ἐγείρω. (AS)
Anna, a prophetess: [[r:LUK.2.36|Luk 2:36.]]† (AS)
Annas, the high priest: [[r:LUK.3.2|Luk 3:2]], [[r:JHN.18.13|Jhn 18:13-24]], [[r:ACT.4.6|Act 4:6]].† (AS)

G0453.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G3539]]
senses: ἀ-νόητος, -ον (ἀ- neg., νοητός; νοέω),
not thought on, not understood (Hom., Plat.).

not understanding, foolish (Hdt., al., LXX): [[r:LUK.24.25|Luk 24:25]], [[r:ROM.1.14|Rom 1:14]], [[r:GAL.3.1|Gal 3:1]], 3, [[r:1TI.6.9|1Ti 6:9]], [[r:TIT.3.3|Tit 3:3]] (Cremer, 438, 790; MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: ἀσύνετος (see Tr., Syn., § LXXv) (AS)

G0454.root: from a compound of [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and [[w:G3563]]
senses: ἀνοια, -ας, ἡ (ἄ-νοος, without understanding), folly, foolishness: [[r:2TI.3.9|2Ti 3:9]]; expressed in violent rage (cf. Plat., Tim., 86B): [[r:LUK.6.11|Luk 6:11.]]† (AS)

G0455.strongs: to open up (literally or figuratively, in various applications)
